scope: Sequential 20-second process CPU/RSS observations on actual Pi5. BiteDJ normal session versus native AZ empty SOURCE screen on private Xvfb with paced null audio. Not matched playback/rendering workloads.
az_visual_review: SOURCE, USB1 present, both decks not loaded; screenshot pi-native-first-display.png

compatibility_fix.bundled_allocator_failure: Unsupported system page size followed by process return134; no systemd core tooling installed, no saved core found in inspected paths.
compatibility_fix.replacement: Debian libjemalloc2 5.2.1-3 arm64, sandbox-only bind over /usr/lib/libjemalloc.so.2
compatibility_fix.validation: Native AZ remained live through45-second bounded probe and screenshot; allocator replacement is a compatibility experiment, not full ABI or long-run validation.

limits: Application process only: excludes compositor/Xvfb, Python pacing launcher and companion services.
AZ software mixer not attached in this startup comparison.
No FLX6, playback, waveforms, physical display FPS, or underrun test.
RSS includes shared pages; not proportional/private memory.
